title: The Antipyretic Effect of High-Dose Paracetamol Versus Mefenamic Acid in the Treatment of Febrile Children: A Randomized Control Trial
text: Standard-dose paracetamol was administered at 15 mg/kg per dose. High-dose paracetamol was administered at 20 mg/kg per dose in the intervention group, ages 6 months to 5 years. Hepatotoxicity with paracetamol is very rare in children if it is used in the therapeutic range (<=75 mg/kg per day orally or intravenously or <=100 mg/kg per day rectally). A single dose of high-dose paracetamol (20 mg/kg/dose) was safe and had a similar antipyretic effect as mefenamic acid.
